name: El Hierro
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole of El Hierro, the smallest of the seven main islands and the westernmost.
